table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Grouping=1,
	DateString = convert(varchar(100), dbo.saleledger.Date, 103),
	dbo.saleledger.Date,
	InvNo = dbo.saleledger.SaleInvCode,
	Customer = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = min(saleledger.custcode)),
	RefNo = (SELECT C.refno FROM Customer C WHERE C.CustCode = min(saleledger.custcode)),
	CustRefNo = dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo,
	ItemCode = item.CustomICode,  
	itemname = item.name,  
	Manufacturer = dbo.Manufacturer.Name,
	packingdesc = dbo.item.packingdesc,
	Packqty = Sum (dbo.saledetail.looseqty), 
	saleprice = dbo.saledetail.saleprice,
	PackUnits = dbo.saledetail.PackUnits,
	ID = MAX(dbo.saledetail.rowid)
FROM 	 
	dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saledetail,    
	dbo.item, 
	dbo.Customer,
	dbo.Manufacturer 
WHERE  
	CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
		When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
		When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.date
		When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.billingdate
	 End Between :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND
	 dbo.saleledger.custcode IN (SELECT CODE FROM DBO.UDF_STRINGTOTABL(:as_custcode,',') ) AND
	 dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) AND
	 dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode AND
	 dbo.saledetail.icode = item.icode AND
	 dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode AND
	 dbo.Item.manfcode = dbo.manufacturer.manfcode AND
	 dbo.saleledger.ImpactInventory = 'Y'
Group by 
	dbo.saleledger.SaleInvCode,
	dbo.saleledger.Date,
	dbo.saledetail.icode,
	dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo,
	item.CustomICode,  
	dbo.item.name,
	dbo.item.packingdesc,
	dbo.saledetail.packunits,
	dbo.saledetail.saleprice,
	dbo.Manufacturer.Name
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	Grouping=1,
	DateString = convert(varchar(100), dbo.saleledger.Date, 103),
	dbo.saleledger.Date,
	InvNo = dbo.saleledger.SaleInvCode,
	Customer = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = min(saleledger.custcode)),
	RefNo = (SELECT C.refno FROM Customer C WHERE C.CustCode = min(saleledger.custcode)),
	CustRefNo = dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo,
	ItemCode = item.CustomICode,  
	itemname = item.name,  
	Manufacturer = dbo.Manufacturer.Name,
	packingdesc = dbo.item.packingdesc,
	Packqty = Sum (saledetail.looseqty), 
	saleprice = saledetail.saleprice,
	PackUnits = saledetail.PackUnits,
	ID = MAX(saledetail.rowid)
FROM 	 
	dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saleinvdetail saledetail,    
	dbo.item, 
	dbo.Customer,
	dbo.Manufacturer 
WHERE  
	CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
		When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
		When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.date
		When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.billingdate
	 End Between :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND
	 dbo.saleledger.custcode IN (SELECT CODE FROM DBO.UDF_STRINGTOTABL(:as_custcode,',') ) AND
	 dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) AND
	 dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode AND
	 saledetail.icode = item.icode AND
	 dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode AND
	 dbo.Item.manfcode = dbo.manufacturer.manfcode AND
	 dbo.saleledger.ImpactInventory = 'N'
Group by 
	dbo.saleledger.SaleInvCode,
	dbo.saleledger.Date,
	saledetail.icode,
	dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo,
	item.CustomICode,  
	dbo.item.name,
	dbo.item.packingdesc,
	saledetail.packunits,
	saledetail.saleprice,
	dbo.Manufacturer.Name
table.sort: datestring A, customer A, long(custrefno) A, itemname A
